brief:
Palestinians and their supporters across Europe have deployed national symbols including the flag and keffiyeh at demonstrations ranging from education to housing campaigns, Al Jazeera English reported. The symbols, historically associated with anti-colonial resistance, have become visible fixtures at mass rallies addressing issues beyond the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.

Some observers have questioned the appropriateness of using Palestinian emblems in European protest contexts, though supporters argue the symbols represent broader struggles against colonialism and oppression. The trend reflects growing solidarity movements among diverse constituencies across the continent.
dek: Symbols such as the flag and keffiyeh represent anti-colonial struggles but some question their use amid mass rallies.
title: Palestinian symbols dominate European protest movements
